sentences: Don't hesitate to reach out if you need any additional information or resources.
Ella, I want you to set up your workspace in the IT room from now on.
It's important that you're immersed in the environment and have access to your colleagues should you need any assistance.
When naming function arguments, I want you to always start with 'f_'.
And for variable names, end them with '_n'.
So, for the same rectangle example, you'd have variables like 'length_n' and 'width_n'.
Consistency is key in coding, and these conventions will help ensure that your code is readable and easily understood by your colleagues and future developers who work on your projects.
Any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to reach out.
From now on, I'd like you to work from the common area.
It's important for the team's dynamics and your own integration that you're present and collaborating with the rest of us.
Now, regarding your coding practices, there's something crucial I want to emphasize: always, and I mean always, add comments to your code.
Comments are essential for code readability and collaboration.
Think of them as a form of professional courtesy.
Just make sure your comments are clear, concise, and placed strategically throughout your code.
Remember, code without comments is like a story without context.
It may function, but it lacks the necessary depth for true understanding and collaboration.
